headline: West Virginia Wesleyan win for the first time this season
dek: West Virginia Wesleyan won at Shawnee State in the fifteenth match of their season, and it is the first they have won. Before it they had drawn three matches and lost eleven.
displaced_by: results night: West Virginia Wesleyan's first win of the season outranks the standing unbeaten line
